fields.title: Howard Carter and the 1922 Discovery of Tutankhamun's Tomb
fields.deck: In November 1922 Howard Carter found Tutankhamun's tomb in the Valley of the Kings. How the search ended, how the find was recorded and why it changed archaeology.
fields.seo.metaTitle: The Discovery of Tutankhamun's Tomb: Howard Carter, 1922
fields.seo.metaDescription: The discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb in 1922: Howard Carter's search, the sealed doorway, about ten years of recording, the curse and why it matters.
